# S.W.A.T. Plumbing LLC

> S.W.A.T. Plumbing LLC is a family-owned, licensed plumbing company serving 49 communities across Tarrant, Parker, Denton, and Johnson counties in North Texas. Founded in 2013 by Dillon and Danielle Patterson, the company operates under Texas Master Plumber License #M-39596 and has been a BBB Accredited Business with an A+ rating since 2014. Services include 24/7 emergency plumbing, drain cleaning, slab leak repair, water heater installation and repair, gas line work, and residential water quality solutions. Two office locations serve the greater Fort Worth metro: Aledo (2111 East FM1187, Aledo TX 76008 — 817-438-6142) and Fort Worth (9905 Camp Bowie W Blvd, Fort Worth TX 76116 — 817-438-6955). 24/7 emergency dispatch is available at both numbers.

## Blog Posts — Educational Content from a Texas Master Plumber

All blog posts authored by Dillon Patterson, Owner & Texas Master Plumber #M-39596.

- [Sewer Line Repair Near Me Fort Worth TX](https://www.swatplumbing.com/blog/sewer-line-repair-near-me-fort-worth-tx): Warning signs of sewer line damage, common causes in Fort Worth soil, and when to call a licensed plumber. Includes camera inspection, hydro jetting, spot repair, and trenchless options.
- [5 Warning Signs of a Slab Leak in Fort Worth Homes](https://www.swatplumbing.com/blog/slab-leak-repair-fort-worth-tx-experts): How to identify a slab leak before it damages your foundation — water bill spikes, warm floors, foundation cracks, low pressure, and running-water sounds. Includes detection methods and repair options.
- [No Hot Water Repair Aledo TX Plumber](https://www.swatplumbing.com/blog/no-hot-water-repair-aledo-tx-plumber): Common causes of no hot water (failed heating elements, pilot light, sediment, thermostat, leaks), what to expect during a repair visit, and when to consider replacement.
- [Water Leak Detection Near Me Aledo TX](https://www.swatplumbing.com/blog/water-leak-detection-near-me-aledo-tx): How professional water leak detection works (acoustic, thermal imaging, pressure testing), common signs of hidden leaks, and causes of plumbing leaks in Texas homes.
- [What Counts as a Plumbing Emergency in Fort Worth?](https://www.swatplumbing.com/blog/24-hour-plumber-fort-worth-tx-fast-response): How Fort Worth homeowners can tell a true plumbing emergency from a wait-til-morning issue. Covers burst pipes, sewer backups, water heater failures, gas leaks, and what to do in the first 10 minutes.
- [Emergency Plumber Near Me in Aledo TX](https://www.swatplumbing.com/blog/emergency-plumber-near-me-in-aledo-tx): The Aledo homeowner's playbook for plumbing emergencies — burst pipes, sewer backups, water heater failures, gas leaks, sudden water loss. What to do first and when to call.
- [No Hot Water in House Fort Worth](https://www.swatplumbing.com/blog/no-hot-water-in-house-fort-worth): Six common causes of no hot water (failed elements, pilot light, sediment, thermostat, leaks, supply issues), tankless-specific issues, and when to repair vs replace.
- [Who to Call With a Gas Smell in House](https://www.swatplumbing.com/blog/who-to-call-with-a-gas-smell-in-house): What to do immediately if you smell gas inside your home, signs of a gas leak, common causes of gas line damage, and why professional gas leak detection matters.
